cards.headline: The lead single that introduced Athena
cards.snippet: In August 2019, American musician Sudan Archives put out "Confessions" as the first single from her debut studio album, Athena. It was released on August 30, 2019. The full album followed on November 1, 2019, on Stones Throw Records. Critics received it very warmly: Metacritic gave it a weighted average of 83 out of 100, based on 15 reviews from mainstream publications.
cards.context: Athena came out November 1, 2019, and Metacritic scored it 83.

cards.headline: Where the name Sudan comes from
cards.snippet: Brittney Parks was nicknamed Sudan when she was a young girl, so when she began making music, using that name felt like the obvious choice. Her first release was the 2014 EP 'Goldencity', put out under the name Sudan Moon. Clash notes that the EP blended classical music, R&B, West African rhythms and experimental electronic sounds. Parks is a self-taught violinist, and that classical side shows up in her work.
cards.context: Clash also describes her as a self-taught violinist.
